execution._note: PAPER ONLY; a recorded exception to CLAUDE.md rule 3 (team lead, 2026-09-29). Alpaca paper runs no closing auction: staff say it treats cls as a market order at the close with random partial fills (forum, 2026-06-24), and on 2026-09-29 eleven of thirteen cls orders expired unfilled although every NYSE closing auction printed more shares than we asked for. So the plan is DECIDED in the evening (morning backstop) and SENT as market day orders 8 to 2 minutes before the calendar close (15:52-15:58 ET; 12:52-12:58 on a 13:00 early close). Verify scores every fill against the official closing print, in bp. Revisit after a week of fills. REVERT: delete this block (the runner then sends cls exactly as before). Not for a live-money account, where the auction exists and rule 3 stands.

data._stale_nav_note: Team lead 2026-10-13 (redesign; report mode first, `on` after a measured week). WHAT: the decide-time stale-NAV gate, quantt/session/nav_gate.py. Yahoo serves a NAV row dated D that carries an older NAV; gate 5 checks only the date (results/cef/LIVE_NAV_QUALITY_2026-10-12.md section 5: 28 of 73 checkable laptop name-days decided on NAV(D-1), 11 orders sized on one). A name whose NAV(D) equals its previous NAV, or CEFConnect's NAV(D-1), is checked against CEFConnect's D: different -> replaced through the logged fallback; equal -> kept; no row or an error -> the decide is deferred to the morning backstop, and from the final check (close - 90 min) the name keeps its current shares, out of the cross-section, never targeted to zero, never the min_names flatten. MODES: absent = off; report = every check and what `on` would do is recorded in plan.json (nav_gate) and <state>/nav_gate.csv, and NOTHING else changes; on = applied. NO-OP PROOF for report: quantt/session/tests/test_nav_gate.py, test_real_sleeve_on_the_real_panel_report_mode_is_byte_identical (live spec, real sleeve, real panel as of 2026-09-25, a held book that trades: same exit, orders, plan_sha and plan.json apart from nav_gate) and test_report_mode_leaves_the_orders_and_the_plan_unchanged (an evening where `on` would defer). CONSEQUENCE accepted: report mode reads CEFConnect once per deployed name at each decide (13 requests); an error there is recorded as UNMEASURED and never stops the session. NOT CHOSEN: `on` now -- the replay (docs/REFERENCES.md section 12s) rests on one week of laptop sessions and on three readings of when CEFConnect publishes D, which the collector now measures. READ BY: quantt/session/run.py stale_nav_for. REVERT: delete this `data` block (the session runs exactly as before the gate). Turning it `on` is another reviewed edit of this key.

risk._drawdown_note: Team lead 2026-10-19 (HALVE/KILL in report mode). WHAT: at every decide the runner measures the book's drawdown from its high-water mark on <state>/eod_equity.csv -- Alpaca's end-of-day portfolio history (1D), the OFFICIAL daily P&L (team lead 2026-10-19), read by header name (date, equity) -- and compares it with the frozen spec's risk.halve_drawdown and risk.kill_drawdown (fractions, units-checked, read through run.py's load_spec, never a literal), quantt/session/drawdown.py. Until this, no code read either line and the runner never called risk_check (results/cef/PORTFOLIO_FRAMEWORK_2026-10-15.md section 1 item 4; re-verified at 832aeaa). MODES: absent = off; report = the status (OK, HALVE, KILL or UNMEASURED) and what an acting mode WOULD do are recorded in plan.json and the run record (`drawdown`) and printed as one DRAWDOWN line, and NOTHING else changes; an acting mode is NOT BUILT and setting one raises (run.drawdown_for). SERIES: eod_equity.csv absent or unreadable is UNMEASURED naming the file, never a fallback to equity.csv, whose after-hours snapshots can set a high-water mark the book never closed at (shown as a second, labelled line only). The newest row must be the as-of date, else UNMEASURED with the stale figures labelled. NO-OP PROOF for report: quantt/session/tests/test_drawdown.py, test_real_sleeve_on_the_real_panel_report_mode_is_byte_identical (live spec, real sleeve, real panel as of 2026-09-25, a held book that trades, the series at OK, HALVE-deep, KILL-deep and absent: same exit, orders, plan_sha, and plan.json byte-identical once `drawdown` is removed) and test_report_mode_records_the_check_and_leaves_the_orders_and_plan_identical. CONSEQUENCE accepted: until the collector release that writes eod_equity.csv is installed, every decide records UNMEASURED; that is the truth, and report mode never blocks. NOT CHOSEN: arming now (the team lead ruled report first); a frozen-spec switch (the levels are already the spec's; whether the runner acts on them is a runner setting, like data.stale_nav); equity.csv as the series (snapshots, above). READ BY: quantt/session/run.py drawdown_for and _drawdown. REVERT: delete this `risk` block (the session runs exactly as before). An acting mode is new code, a test that fails without it, and another reviewed edit of this key.

corporate_actions._note: Team lead 2026-10-28 (a HALT guard for the paper runner). WHY: Alpaca paper processes no corporate actions, no splits and no mergers (two Alpaca staff forum replies, docs/REFERENCES.md section 12pc), and IBKR paper none either, so paper stays on Alpaca. The runner reads broker share counts as they are; a held fund that reverse-splits 1:4 keeps its old count on paper at four times the price, and the plan and its orders are sized on the wrong exposure. WHAT: at every decide, and again at the late-market send on fresh reads, the runner reads Alpaca's non-dividend corporate actions (reverse/forward/unit split, stock dividend, spin-off, cash/stock/stock-and-cash merger, redemption, name change, worthless removal, reorganization, partial call) for every held and targeted name, in any role (an acquirer included), and keeps those dated inside the name's window: a held name from the day its shares were last set (its last filled order, from the account's own history) or the as-of date if earlier, a target-only name from the as-of date, both through the session date (quantt/session/corp_actions.py, THE WINDOW). MODES: absent = no gate, today's behaviour; report = record in plan.json, the run record and send.json, print, and send anyway, with a failed read recorded as UNMEASURED, never as clear; halt = refuse the session through the existing refusal path (a gate-5 data refusal, exit 11 REFUSED, nothing sent) naming each event, and refuse too when the read fails or cannot be parsed, naming the error. NO-OP PROOF for absent and report: quantt/session/tests/test_corp_actions.py, test_the_key_absent_reads_nothing_and_records_nothing and test_report_changes_nothing_that_trades (report against absent with a blocking event: same exit, same orders sent, plan.json identical once corporate_actions is removed); the existing session suite passes unchanged. CONSEQUENCE accepted: a halt does not clear by itself. While it refuses, nothing trades and the window keeps the event; it clears when the name's shares are set again after the event (a person's order, CLAUDE.md order-path rule 1) or when this mode is set to report. verify reads a refused day as MISSED (a FAIL), on purpose. Every decide reads the whole closed-order history and the market's non-dividend actions over the padded window (a few pages). NOT CHOSEN: report first (the team lead ruled halt); a server-side symbols filter (the reference does not say which field it matches on a merger, so a held acquirer could be dropped in silence); a window of the as-of and session dates only (Alpaca lists mergers late, so an action could slide out of view while the paper count stays wrong); rights distributions (no share count changes; paper credits no distributions either). READ BY: quantt/session/run.py corporate_actions_for and _corporate_actions. REVERT: delete this block (the session runs exactly as before the gate).
